card.name: Punctuation after drug-interaction headings
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a space right after a heading in a Drug Interactions section, such as a colon, open parenthesis or space after a drug class or enzyme name. It also fires on commas or periods ending a sentence about interactions.

modes.label: After interaction subheading
modes.description: A colon, space or parenthesis right after a drug class or enzyme name that heads an interaction entry.
modes.example: Drug Interactions Neprilysin Inhibitors<<:>> Patients taking concomitant nepril
